scope: Starter tool development on RTX 3060 12 GB, 128 GB RAM. The first native build had the tool offered but no focused selector; it ignored the tool. Fixed engine checks and subsequent selector trial are separate evidence. Not a pure-model coding improvement or model qualification.

runs.brief:
Create index.html, a complete offline HTML space shooter, using your project tools.
Build a real canvas game with stars, player ship, enemies, bullets, score, lives,
waves, game over and Enter restart. Fit small screens. Arrow keys/A-D move,
Space shoots. No external assets. Use seconds-based timing at 120 pixels/second.
Canvas logical size is 600x800, player center starts x=300, half-width=20.
Expose the SAME live state and functions used for gameplay as window.game:
{player:{x,y,w,h,invincible},bullets:[],enemies:[],score,lives,wave,playing,
waveSpawned,update(dt,keys),reset()}. keys contains ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/KeyA/KeyD/Space
booleans. Enemy/bullet objects use centered x,y,w,h and speed, enemy hp defaults1.
update(0,{}) resolves existing collisions. Each killed enemy scores10.
A player hit removes one life with at least1 second invulnerability. At zero
lives playing=false. reset() starts play with score0/lives3/wave1/player.x300
and no bullets. An empty wave advances after waveSpawned=true regardless of
score. Only positive-area rectangle overlap counts. Clear keys on blur.
Return a complete playable game, not just an API or a picture.
 Save actual files, not JSON in chat. Use task_steps for at least two tiny SQLite units, finish their real checks and create/run a repeatable verifier. Show a visible HUD with score, lives and wave. Test real keyboard movement, shooting and restart, not just text presence. Expose the requested window.game object as the actual live game state, not a separate test implementation. Keep all JavaScript inline in index.html for this single-file game.
runs.error: ToolArgumentError: Invalid arguments for tool task_steps: Schema rule type: expected "array"; received JSON string.

Latest 67.51-second run used a factory engine and completed seven local inference calls plus real automatic checks. The bounded review returned invalid schema and normal workflow safely completed. Existing raw-model failures remain failures; no model approval or game ranking was changed.
